title: Vi söker mekaniker till TCR Arlanda
description: Mekaniker sökes till TCR Arlanda!Om företagetTCR Sweden AB är en del av TCR Group som leasar ut, servar och utför underhåll på GSE (Ground support Equipment) inom civil luftfart. Exempel på GSE är push-back truckar, deiceingfordon, eldrivna fordon och bagagehanteringsutrustning. TCR är ett expansivt och snabbt växande företag som har ett 60-tal verkstäder och finns representerade på över 100 flygplatser runt om i världen. I Sverige finns TCR representerade på två flygplatser och vi står inför många spännande utmaningar. På Arlanda finns vi i fräscha lokaler och har påbörjat en spännande resa där vi utvecklar vårt verkstadskoncept. Vi söker nu en driven mekaniker och erbjuder rätt person ett varierande jobb i ett internationellt företag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. Om tjänstenHar du ett stort mekaniskt intresse och vill spendera dina dagar med att underhålla och reparera olika typer av fordon? Då kan arbetet som mekaniker på TCR vara något för dig! Rollen som mekaniker är ett roligt och stimulerade arbete för dig som är vill reparera olika typer av fordon och därmed bredda dina kunskaper inom yrket. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar reparationer och underhåll av personbilar, anläggningsutrustning och fordon såsom bagagevagnar. Dessutom genomför du tillsammans med dina kollegor felsökningar av diverse fordonstyper. Vi ser därför att du som person har en mekanisk bakgrund och en vilja att lära dig ännu mera. Utöver ett spännande och varierande arbete på ett internationellt företag, finns också goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som är ambitiös. Du erbjuds dessutom en konkurrenskraftig lön och goda förmåner. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:• Felsökning och diagnostisering av stora och små fordon (personbil, lastbil och specialfordon). • Utföra service, reparationer och underhåll på de fordon som verkstaden hanterar. • Problemlösning och felsökning tillsammans med både svenska och utländska leverantörer Din profilVi söker dig med något/några års erfarenhet som mekaniker med ett brinnande intresse för mekanik. Du som person är lösningsorienterad och tekniskt lagd. Du har vana av att arbeta med datorer och arbetsordersystem för verkstäder. Som person är du initiativrik, självgående och noggrann. Du arbetar strukturerat och målinriktat, och fäster stor vikt vid att skapa gemensamma resultat genom att vara lösnings- och förbättringsorienterad. Goda kommunikationsgemenskaper skriftligt och muntligt i svenska är ett krav. Du måste också ha B-körkort. Vi erbjuder en spännande och varierande position inom ett växande företag i Skandinavien och Sverige. Du kommer rapportera direkt till workshop manager.Tjänsten är på heltid med start efter överenskommelse. Detta är en rekrytering och du blir därför anställd direkt hos TCR. Vid ytterligare frågor, vänligen kontakta Alexis Camacho på 076 589 00 07. Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Passa därför på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Head of Business IT Support Services till Saab Aeronautics
description: Saab is a place where teamwork makes things fly. Literally. Join us and experience our supportive and friendly workplace. Head of Business IT Support ServicesWe are looking for a leader to take responsibility for Business IT Support Services, a key capability area within our Aeronautics IT organization.The area provides close-to-business IT support, red environment support, asset management, IT service management and tailored business solutions that enable efficient day-to-day operations. Working closely with Group IT and other areas, the organization connects common IT services with the specific needs of our business and provides support to our global operations and locations.As Head of Business IT Support Services, you will set the direction and drive the continued development of these capabilities, with a strong focus on business needs, service quality and user experience. A key part of the role is to make IT services easier to understand and consume, while ensuring that business-specific requirements are effectively addressed.The role combines operational responsibility with service development and transformation. You will drive improvements in business-facing support, ITSM processes, asset lifecycle management and tailored business solutions, while strengthening the interfaces between the business, our IT organization and Group IT.You will lead through other leaders and work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand current and future needs, improve service delivery and support the continued growth and digitalization of the business.In this role, you will    Ensure high-quality, business-oriented IT support and local service delivery.    Strengthen the interface between the business, our organization and Group IT.    Drive the development and adoption of effective ITSM processes and ways of working.    Ensure effective lifecycle management of IT assets and related services.    Manage and develop tailored IT solutions supporting business needs not covered by common enterprise, production or engineering solutions.    Support the IT needs of our global operations, including the establishment and enablement of new offices and locations.    Improve service clarity, ownership and ease of consumption for the business.    Drive standardization, automation and continuous improvement while maintaining the ability to respond to business-specific needs.    Develop the competencies and capabilities required to support continued business growth and digitalization.Your profileWe are looking for an experienced leader with a strong background in business-facing IT, IT service delivery or operational IT environments.You have experience leading and developing service-oriented organizations and understand how to combine common and standardized IT services with business-specific requirements. Experience from ITSM, support operations, asset management, business applications or international IT operations is valuable.You are a relationship-oriented leader with strong business understanding and a clear service mindset. You are comfortable leading through others, driving change and creating collaboration across organizational boundaries.You have the ability to translate business needs into practical IT services and solutions and to work effectively across the interface between local business requirements and enterprise-wide IT capabilities.What you will be part of Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 30,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Doctoral student in Mechanical Engineering - specialisation in wire drawing
description: Örebro University and the School of Science and Technology are looking for a doctoral student for the doctoral programme in Mechanical Engineering, concluding with a doctoral degree.Start date: January – March 2027.Project descriptionSteel wire is an essential component of countless products and applications, from everyday items such as ballpoint pens and car tyres to critical infrastructure such as buildings and bridges. As industry advances towards more sustainable manufacturing, there is an increasing need to produce steel wire products with greater resource efficiency, improved material performance, and reduced environmental impact.This doctoral project aims to advance the knowledge and technologies needed to make wire drawing processes more efficient, robust, and sustainable. The research is carried out in close collaboration with the wire drawing industry, ensuring that scientific developments address real industrial challenges and contribute to more sustainable production of steel wire products. Particular emphasis will be placed on improving process understanding and developing and evaluating innovative drawing tools.The research will combine experimental investigations of wire drawing processes, tool behaviour, and resulting wire properties with sensor-based measurements, data analysis, and modelling. A central objective is to understand how material properties, process conditions, lubrication, and tooling interact and influence process performance, tool wear, and wire quality. This knowledge will support the development of practical solutions that improve resource utilisation, extend tool life, and enhance the efficiency and sustainability of industrial wire drawing.As a doctoral student, you will plan and conduct experiments, analyse data, develop models, and communicate your findings through scientific publications and presentations. You will work closely with academic researchers and industrial partners, contributing to research that bridges fundamental scientific understanding and practical industrial applications.The project offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the intersection of mechanical engineering, manufacturing technology, materials engineering, measurement technology, modelling, and control engineering. By addressing challenges associated with resource efficiency, production performance, and the green transition, the research aims to contribute to the development of next-generation wire drawing processes and tools that support more sustainable steel wire production.Supervision: The doctoral student will be supervised by Christer Korin (principal supervisor) and Joakim Larsson (assistant supervisor).The programme and the doctoral studentshipThe doctoral programme consists of courses and an independent research project that you will present in a doctoral thesis. The programme concludes with a doctoral degree and comprises 240 credits, which corresponds to four years of full-time study.Our ambition is for your doctoral studies to be stimulating and purposeful throughout the programme until you have obtained your doctoral degree. A thorough introduction will therefore get you off to a good start and provide a solid foundation on which you can build your studies. As a doctoral student at Örebro University, you will be offered a specially tailored seminar series, covering matters ranging from doctoral programme rules and careers to support during the study period and networking.The place on the programme is linked to a full-time doctoral studentship for the duration of the study programme, which corresponds to four years of full-time study. More information on doctoral studentships, part-time studies and part-time doctoral studentships can be found on https://www.oru.se/english/study/doctoral-studies/how-to-become-a-doctoral-student/. The initial salary for a doctoral studentship is SEK 32 300 a month (salary period 2025-2026).Entry requirements and selectionTo see the job advertisement in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260303InformationFor more information about the programme and the doctoral studentship, contact Joakim Larsson, Associate Senior Lecturer, joakim.larsson@oru.se, +4619303378 or Christer Korin, Senior Lecturer, christer.korin@oru.se, +4619303082.At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.Application to the programme and for the doctoral studentshipThe application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:    CV    Copies of the original certificate and official transcript for Bachelor's degree    Copies of the original certificate and official transcript for Master's degree    Independent project (degree project)    Other relevant documents, course and degree certificates verifying eligibilityAs a main rule, application documents and attachments are to be written in Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, or English. Certificates and documents in other languages verifying your qualifications and experience must be translated by an authorised translator to Swedish or English. A list of authorised translators can be obtained from Kammarkollegiet (the Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency), http://www.kammarkollegiet.se/engelska/start.When you apply for admission, you automatically also apply for a doctoral studentship.More information for applicants will be found on our career site:  https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/The application deadline is 2026-12-18. We look forward to receiving your application!As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

title: Competence Development Specialist
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Are you a technically interested person with hard skills within heat exchangers AND have a passion for sharing knowledge and educating others? Then we believe this might be your dream role. As a Competence Development Specialist, you will be part of a global competence development team and play a key role in shaping the skills and expertise of colleagues and partners worldwide.  Your job is to deliver comprehensive product and application training sessions focused on Hygienic Heat Exchangers for the food and pharmaceutical industries. You will facilitate both on-site and hands-on training at global product training hubs, with sessions typically lasting two to five days.  Key Responsibilities:     Support the development and delivery of training, engaging with process and project engineers as well as field service professionals.     Collaborate with regional product and application teams, acting as a "train the trainer" to ensure consistent and effective knowledge transfer across regions.     Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance learning materials and methods.     Assess training needs and adapt programs to meet the requirements of diverse audiences, including field sales, technical support, and service teams.     Provide ongoing mentorship and support to trainees, fostering knowledge retention and practical application.     Maintain and update training documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance.  Global travel is part of the job, approximately 50-70 days per year with 12-15 training sessions per year. Trips often combining multiple sessions to deliver impactful learning experiences and you will be away for one week at a time. We have a solid understanding for our employees need to be able to balance work and family life and travels are mostly planned. You will be part of a diverse, experienced, and supportive team of ten and report to Ole Andersen, a trust-based and empowering leader who leads with clear expectations. We offer you a role with diverse, multicultural environments where collaboration and inclusion are highly valued. With Alfa Laval you will get to grow a global network of professionals.  Who are you We are looking for you who truly enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others grow their technical skills. You are curious and open-minded and have the drive to inspire others and continuously seek new ways to make learning engaging. You thrive in diverse, multicultural environments, are approachable, eager to grow and enjoy working as part of a team. What you know Requirements:     Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, or a related field.     Solid technical background in Heat exchanger industry, ideally within the food and pharmaceutical industries.     Experience in technical training, product knowledge transfer, or hands-on service/engineering roles.     Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex technical information accessible and engaging.     Experience with "train the trainer" programs or similar knowledge-sharing initiatives is an advantage.     Familiarity with tools such as PowerPoint, experience with usage of case studies, and hands-on assignments.     Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, additional language skills are a plus.  Merit:     Experience with practical application of AI in a, for this role, relevant area.  If you're motivated to make a real impact through competence development and enjoy connecting with people from all backgrounds, we'd love to hear from you.   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications, and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund (Sweden) or Kolding or Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  For internal candidates: this position can also be based in HFH P&A hubs around the world: USA - Kenosha, Mexico, India - Pune, China - Shanghai, SEA region.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. title: People Business Partner
description: E.ON is one of Europe's largest operators of energy networks and infrastructure and a provider of innovative energy solutions. Our employees are constantly working to digitise the energy world, achieve net zero and connect everyone to good energy. To achieve this, we are focusing our actions on sustainability, digitalisation and growth. We strongly believe that differences make us stronger and welcome all people into our inclusive and diverse culture.Inom E.ON Energiinfrastruktur skapar vi energilösningar som gör skillnad för våra kunder och samhället. Nu välkomnar vi en People Business Partner som vill arbeta nära vår fjärrvärmeverksamhet. Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Researcher in plant breeding, genomics, and sensory and nutritional quality
description: Department of Plant BreedingWe are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a strong background in genetics, genomics and crop improvementAbout the positionThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.The candidate will lead experimental and analytical work within the subject and collaborate with other researchers and students in the group as well as outside the organisation.The work will include:    Analyse Genotyping by sequencing (GBS) data (quality control, read mapping and SNP calling)    Genome-wide association studies (GWAS)    Field evaluation and phenotyping of diverse germplasm    Data analysis, interpretation, and preparation of scientific publications within the subject    Participate in collaborative research activities and supervision of students    Apply for external research fundingYour profileQualification requirementsThe following qualifications are required:    A PhD in plant genetics, plant breeding, agriculture, or a related field    Good understanding of the genetic basis of complex quantitative traits    Experience with GBS data and GWAS    Experience with nutritional quality traits in crops    Experience with metabolomic and ionomic profiling including the integration and analysis of multi-omics datasets    Experience with advanced statistical methods for analysing genetic and phenotypic data    Practical experience with field experiments, data collection and phenotyping    Good skills in the programming language R or a comparable language    Very good written and oral English skillsThe candidate must be able to take a leading role in research development as well as to collaborate in research groups and have good overall communication skills.Additional qualificationsThe following qualifications are meritorious:    Experience in plant pathology and/or plant physiology    Machine learning, artificial intelligence or other data-driven approaches to biological datasetsAssessment criteriaAssessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Emphasis will be placed on documented experience in field phenotyping and analysis of genetic data.The evaluation will also consider the applicant’s ability to conduct independent research, collaborate within a multidisciplinary research environment, and communicate scientific results through publications and presentations.About usThe position focuses on understanding the genetic basis of disease resistance and grain nutrient quality in wheat and lentil, with particular emphasis on micronutrients such as iron and zinc. The overall objective is to identify genetic regions and markers associated with resistance, nutritional and quality traits which can contribute to future breeding efforts. The position will also contribute to the development of data-driven approaches for crop improvement and food innovation. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating advanced genomic and phenotypic approaches with metabolomic and ionomic analyses, food processing and emerging artificial intelligence approaches, within a research environment working at the interface of genetics and pre-breeding/crop improvement.For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/vf_en/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:AlnarpForm of employment:Permanent positionScope:100%Start date:2027-02-01 or as agreedApplication:Please submit your application before deadline 24 of November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer | Sweden
description: Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years    To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.    To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.    To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.    To work with the best.    Excellent package on offer with room for negotiationsAbout Kirby Group EngineeringKirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.Lead Mechanical Engineer – Data Centre ProjectThis is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind procedures or wait for instructions.We’re looking for a Lead Mechanical Engineer to take full ownership of mechanical engineering and commissioning delivery on a major data centre project. This role sits right at the centre of the project — technically, operationally and commercially.If you enjoy complexity, accountability and leading engineers in an environment where mistakes are expensive and success is visible, you’ll feel at home here.The RoleAs Lead Mechanical Engineer, you are responsible for planning, managing and coordinating all mechanical engineering and commissioning activities on the project.You lead the mechanical engineering function end to end — design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning and handover — while mentoring engineers and maintaining standards under pressure.This is a hands‑on leadership role. You are expected to make decisions, solve problems and keep things moving.What You’ll Be Doing You will:    Take full responsibility for mechanical engineering delivery on the project    Lead and manage the mechanical project engineering team, assigning engineers to work packages    Own the design management process, either directly or through appointed leads    Own the commissioning process, ensuring systems are buildable, testable and ready when required    Drive EHS compliance, promoting safe systems of work and leading by example on site    Oversee procurement from a technical perspective, including RFQs, technical evaluations, equipment selection and delivery tracking    Control quality from design through installation and commissioning, including ITPs, test packs, FATs, SATs, walkdowns and system handover    Coordinate closely with Electrical and CSA counterparts to ensure clear system boundaries and responsibilities    Manage system trackers, technical submittals, RFIs, deviations and change from a technical standpoint    Lead commissioning activities, flushing, balancing, pressure testing and certification    Identify risks early, own mitigation plans and escalate when required    Engage in programme development, commissioning sequencing and look‑ahead planning    Support business development through strong client, designer and contractor relationships    Mentor project and graduate engineers, building capability across the team    Provide clear, structured reporting to senior engineering and business leadershipIn short, you make sure the mechanical scope works — technically, safely and commercially.The ProjectThis is a large‑scale, mission‑critical data centre build.It’s fast, complex and highly coordinated. The client expects certainty, not excuses. Engineering decisions matter, sequencing matters and leadership matters.If you’ve worked on data centres, pharma or advanced industrial projects before, you’ll understand the pace and precision required.Who We Are – Kirby Group EngineeringKirby is one of Europe’s leading mechanical and electrical engineering contractors, delivering complex projects across data centres, life sciences, industrial and advanced manufacturing sectors.We are engineers first. We self‑deliver, we take responsibility, and we are trusted on projects where failure is not an option.While Kirby is well established across Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe, Italy is a strategic growth market for us. This project is part of that expansion.That means this role comes with real influence. You are not joining a mature, over‑layered organisation — you are helping to shape how Kirby is delivered and recognised in Italy.If you want to be known for delivery rather than job titles, this matters.About YouYou’ll likely have:    Strong senior‑level mechanical engineering experience on large, complex projects    Experience in data centres, pharmaceutical, industrial or mission‑critical environments    The ability to lead engineers without micromanaging them    Confidence working with clients, designers and site teams    A practical mindset — structured, calm and solutions‑focusedYou don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room. You do need to be the one people trust when things get difficult.Why Join Kirby Group Engineering?    A flagship data centre project in Denmark    Real ownership of mechanical engineering delivery    Strong backing from a proven European engineering contractor    Long‑term career opportunity as Kirby grows    A culture that values engineering judgement over box‑tickingFor more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies – Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

title: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en subject, RAI, at the Department of Computer Science and Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology, is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team is conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on aerial, space and bioinspired robotics. Subject description Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks. Project description The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution. The RAI team has a strong European and National participation in multiple R&D&I projects. Duties As a PhD student you will perform research with substantial theoretical and experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed major international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of MSc and to assist in grant applications from research funding agencies/councils, the EU framework program or the industry. The position might also involve teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will be working in the field of robotic autonomy and all activities will be linked with National, European and worldwide R&D Projects. The research topic is in the area of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in the area of designing, experimenting and theoretical development, with the following research areas providing a template for relevant directions: Autonomous Underwater Robot Navigation in Aquatic Environments - Optimization-based path planning in aquatic environments - State Estimation and Sensor Fusion for Localization and Mapping - Reactive terrain-aware navigation in dynamic and unstructured environments Experimental validation on robotic platforms in the field Qualifications To be qualified for the position, you must have a MSc degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or Computer Science or Agricultural engineering or related subject. Perfect scientific skills with excellence in real life experimentation, as well as very good communication skills are considered as a strong plus. You will represent the group in different occasions, both in Sweden and world-wide, hence very good knowledge in English is a must. For further information about Robotics and artificial intelligence subject see  http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en Further information Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: 1 January, 2027 For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role. For further information about the position, please contact: George Nikolakopoulos, Chaired Professor, +46 920-49 1298 mailto:geonik@ltu.se https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontacts In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence. description: Job DescriptionBusiness Development & Delivery (BD&D) sits within the H&M Group Strategy function and acts as the bridge between strategic intent and execution, ensuring that our company not only sets ambitious goals but achieves them efficiently through well-defined business development plans, strong processes and a win-win collaboration approach. This is a role for someone who thrives on turning ambiguity into structured action, driving alignment across complex organizations, and making things happen in cross-functional environments. WHO YOU ARE Success in this role requires exceptional stakeholder management and facilitation skills, the ability to structure and solve complex problems, and a talent for shaping clear, compelling messages out of abstract and nuanced material. You combine strategic thinking with strong analytical capability and a proactive mindset, taking ownership of initiatives and driving them from concept to high‑quality outcomes. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross‑functional teams to drive prioritisation, governance and effective decision‑making, ensuring strategic goals translate into tangible results. Comfortable operating across levels, you understand differing perspectives and influence with clarity and credibility – confidently challenging senior stakeholders when needed. To succeed in this role, you also have:     ~2-4 years of experience from a top-tier strategy consulting firm with a strong track record of delivering in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.     Strong analytical capability, comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative data to build a compelling case or recommendation.     Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously without dropping the ball.     High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word as well as AI tools such as Claude and Copilot - able to produce senior-ready output independently and at pace. WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here.  JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. This is a permanent position based in Stockholm. title: Orthopedic Surgeon to AniCura Kalmar Animal Hospital
description: Orthopedic Surgeon to AniCura Kalmar Animal Hospital About AniCura Kalmarsund Animal Hospital Imagine stepping into an animal hospital where the possibilities are extensive, the equipment is state-of-the-art and the ambitions are high. A place where ideas are encouraged, expertise can flourish and where, together, we can make a real difference for animals and their owners in entirely new ways. In early 2027, we will open the doors to a brand-new animal hospital in the heart of Kalmar. This is a major investment in the future of veterinary care and will be the only animal hospital in Kalmar County. We are building a facility with the capacity, expertise and equipment to handle everything from emergency cases to complex medical and surgical challenges. The hospital will feature four state-of-the-art operating theatres, an intensive care unit (ICU), an inpatient ward, an emergency department, rehabilitation facilities and a completely separate dental department. In addition, we will offer advanced diagnostic imaging, including MRI and CT, orthopaedics, modern medical technology that opens up new treatment possibilities, and an advanced laboratory. But what will truly make this hospital exceptional is not just the building, equipment or technology. It is the people who will bring it to life. Their expertise, curiosity, willingness to develop and ambition to continuously improve. This is your opportunity to be part of something significant from the very beginning. To influence, develop and build a new operation alongside colleagues who share your passion for veterinary medicine. The animal hospital of the future is taking shape in Kalmar. The question is - will you be part of it? Who We Are Looking For: We are now looking for an experienced veterinary surgeon with a strong interest and proven expertise in orthopaedics, soft tissue surgery and arthroscopy. You will play a central role in developing and shaping our orthopaedic service, with access to a state-of-the-art surgical environment featuring four spacious operating theatres, two of which are dedicated to orthopaedics. Our equipment includes CT, an arthroscopy tower and a C-arm fluoroscopy system - providing excellent conditions for advanced diagnostics and surgical procedures. You will become part of an experienced and dedicated team of veterinary nurses, veterinary surgeons and veterinary care assistants, all accustomed to working with advanced surgical cases. Together, you will manage everything from orthopaedic investigations to complex surgical procedures, treating both referral patients and emergency cases. You will also work closely with colleagues in anaesthesia, neurology, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. About the Role As an Orthopaedic Veterinary Surgeon, you will play an important role in establishing and developing our service. You will have considerable scope to influence both clinical practice and the future direction of our orthopaedic offering. Your responsibilities will include: Performing advanced orthopaedic investigations and surgical procedures. Carrying out procedures such as TPLO, fracture repair, arthroscopy, patellar surgery and other orthopaedic interventions. Managing both referral patients and emergency orthopaedic cases. Working closely with our teams in surgery, neurology, anaesthesia, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. Contributing to the development of clinical practices, protocols and future treatment opportunities. Sharing your expertise, mentoring colleagues and fostering a strong culture of knowledge exchange. This is more than the next step in your veterinary career. It is an opportunity to build something from the ground up, influence its direction and leave your mark on an entirely new orthopaedic service. We are building the animal hospital of the future in Kalmar. Would you like to help write its first chapter? About AniCura Sweden Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that creates excellent opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation and professional development. With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with hospitals and clinics across the country and a strong local presence. Our dedicated teams work together to provide the best possible care for every patient, every day. Through a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and medical excellence, we offer opportunities to grow, make an impact and truly make a difference. We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension, insurance and a wellness allowance, as well as excellent opportunities for continuous professional development throughout your career. Salary and benefits We offer competitive compensation packages based on your experience, competencies and role. Salary and benefits are discussed individually and transparently during the recruitment process. Interested? We warmly welcome your application! Applications and interviews are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The starting date is negotiable. Please note that the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026. We value diversity and welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - we believe this contributes to greater quality and innovation in everything we do. Please attach a copy of your veterinary licence issued by the Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket) when submitting your application. For questions about the recruitment process or the position, please feel free to contact: Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Idman talent@anicura.se

title: Director Biostatistician at Asahi Kasei Therapeutics
description: About AKTXAsahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. AKTX is a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon their strong heritage of scientific innovation, AKTX aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions.The Asahi Kasei Group operates with a commitment of creating for tomorrow. Their business sectors, Material, Homes, and Health Care, contribute to the development of society by anticipating the changing needs of those around the world. AKTX is looking for candidates that offer a fresh perspective and a variety of skills to help them achieve their commitment.AKTX’s MissionPioneering innovation to continue addressing unmet medical needs, now and into the futureAKTX’s VisionPositively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the worldAKTX’s ValuesAgility, Integrity, Innovation, Expertise and AccountabilityDiversity, Equity & InclusionAt Asahi Kasei Therapeutics, they believe that diverse perspectives strengthen innovation and help them better serve patients, colleagues, and communities around the world. They are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity, respect, and fairness and where all employees can contribute and succeed.AKTX is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.About the position as Director BiostatisticianAs Director Biostatistician, you will be the strategic statistical lead for clinical development programs, responsible for statistical rigor, consistency and quality across all studies within each program. Partnering closely with cross-functional leaders, you will help shape development strategy and guide study designs, as well as recommend the methodologies, estimands and endpoints that best support program objectives.The role also includes overseeing statistical deliverables from internal and external partners, providing clear direction for outsourced work and acting as the escalation point for complex statistical issues. In addition, you will contribute to integrated database planning and, where applicable, the use of external and real-world data, while anticipating data needs for interim analyses, adaptive trials and regulatory interactions.The analyses you oversee will underpin regulatory strategy, publications, safety evaluations and internal decision-making. When engaging with health authorities, you will act as the statistical representative, preparing responses to their questions and attending regulatory meetings in compliance with ICH guidelines and best practices in clinical statistics. Within cross-functional teams, safety review committees and governance meetings, you will translate complex statistical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-statisticians.Key responsibilities include:    Provide strategic input into clinical development plans, target product profiles, and overall program strategy.    Advise on quantitative decision making, including go/no go criteria, dose selection, and adaptive design strategies.    Collaborate with Clinical Development to design scientifically sound and efficient clinical trials across phases (First-in-Human through registration)    Provide oversight and review of statistical sections of protocols, SAPs, and mock TLFs for individual studies.    Oversee statistical and programming activities conducted by CROs and external vendors across all studies in the program.    Work with Data Management to ensure data collection standards, CDISC compliance, and data structures are optimized for cross study analysis.    Provide clear interpretation and communication of statistical results to clinical, regulatory, and senior leadership stakeholders.    Lead statistical components of regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, CTA, BLA, MAA).    Provide mentorship and guidance to study statisticians and junior team membersAbout youYou have the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions, and you have a strong collaboration mindset with high attention to scientific and operational quality. You are comfortable with a hands-on role, stepping in as a subject matter expert where needed and you lead with clarity, integrity and accountability. You work well across functions, locations and cultures.Requirements:    MSc or PhD in Biostatistics or Statistics    Significant experience (7+ years) in clinical trial statistics within biotech/pharma.    Proven track record of leading statistical activities across multiple programs.    Strong working knowledge of regulatory guidelines (ICH, FDA, EMA) and statistical principles in drug development.    Expertise in SAS; familiarity with R is beneficial.    Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.    Ability to balance hands-on work with strategic program oversightPreferred qualifications:    Demonstrated ability to manage CROs and external statistical partners.    Experience with adaptive or innovative designs.    Exposure to early-stage development or rare/complex diseases.    Experience collaborating with Medical AffairsWhat AKTX offersMake an ImpactContribute to therapies that improve the lives of patients around the world.Build Something NewHelp shape the future of Asahi Kasei Therapeutics as they bring together expertise, people, and capabilities into one global organization.One Global TeamWork alongside colleagues across Europe, the United States, and Japan in a collaborative and inclusive environment.Grow With AKTXEnjoy opportunities for development, flexible working arrangements, and competitive local benefits.

title: Integration specialist

Group standards while taking JV requirements and constraints into account.     Support project negotiations when required. 3.    Enable communication and alignment     Drive structured communication across Volvo Group and DongFeng divisions, business areas, group functions and business units.     Connect global, regional and JV-specific priorities.     Support the Head of China JV Office and the leadership team with clear internal communication, decision tracking and execution follow-up. 4.    Manage JV and external stakeholders     Act as a key interface with JV partners, shareholders and other external stakeholders.     Coordinate communication between Volvo Group entities and JV counterparts, ensuring clarity and compliance.     Support executive interactions, including board meetings, shareholder discussions and strategic dialogues.     Maintain consistent and professional external communication. 5.    Support strategy and transformation     Support leaders in defining and delivering JV strategy and transformation initiatives.     Translate strategic direction into actionable programs and governance structures.     Provide structured analysis, reporting and insights title: Competence Development Specialist
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Are you a technically interested person with hard skills within heat exchangers AND have a passion for sharing knowledge and educating others? Then we believe this might be your dream role. As a Competence Development Specialist, you will be part of a global competence development team and play a key role in shaping the skills and expertise of colleagues and partners worldwide.  Your job is to deliver comprehensive product and application training sessions focused on Hygienic Heat Exchangers for the food and pharmaceutical industries. You will facilitate both on-site and hands-on training at global product training hubs, with sessions typically lasting two to five days.  Key Responsibilities:     Support the development and delivery of training, engaging with process and project engineers as well as field service professionals.     Collaborate with regional product and application teams, acting as a "train the trainer" to ensure consistent and effective knowledge transfer across regions.     Contribute ideas and feedback to enhance learning materials and methods.     Assess training needs and adapt programs to meet the requirements of diverse audiences, including field sales, technical support, and service teams.     Provide ongoing mentorship and support to trainees, fostering knowledge retention and practical application.     Maintain and update training documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance.  Global travel is part of the job, approximately 50-70 days per year with 12-15 training sessions per year. Trips often combining multiple sessions to deliver impactful learning experiences and you will be away for one week at a time. We have a solid understanding for our employees need to be able to balance work and family life and travels are mostly planned. You will be part of a diverse, experienced, and supportive team of ten and report to Ole Andersen, a trust-based and empowering leader who leads with clear expectations. We offer you a role with diverse, multicultural environments where collaboration and inclusion are highly valued. With Alfa Laval you will get to grow a global network of professionals.  Who are you We are looking for you who truly enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others grow their technical skills. You are curious and open-minded and have the drive to inspire others and continuously seek new ways to make learning engaging. You thrive in diverse, multicultural environments, are approachable, eager to grow and enjoy working as part of a team. What you know Requirements:     Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, or a related field.     Solid technical background in Heat exchanger industry, ideally within the food and pharmaceutical industries.     Experience in technical training, product knowledge transfer, or hands-on service/engineering roles.     Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex technical information accessible and engaging.     Experience with "train the trainer" programs or similar knowledge-sharing initiatives is an advantage.     Familiarity with tools such as PowerPoint, experience with usage of case studies, and hands-on assignments.     Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, additional language skills are a plus.  Merit:     Experience with practical application of AI in a, for this role, relevant area.  If you're motivated to make a real impact through competence development and enjoy connecting with people from all backgrounds, we'd love to hear from you.   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications, and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund (Sweden) or Kolding or Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  For internal candidates: this position can also be based in HFH P&A hubs around the world: USA - Kenosha, Mexico, India - Pune, China - Shanghai, SEA region.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games. As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

Du erarbeitest und bewertest Integrationslösungen, Betriebskonzepte und Umsetzungs\-Roadmaps.* Du stellst die Entwicklungsqualität über den gesamten Produktionsprozess sicher.* Du übernimmst das Solution Design für unsere digitalen Lösungen basierend auf MuleSoft.**Unsere Erwartungen an Dich:*** Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Informatik.* Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Integrations\-Projekten, vorzugsweise unter Verwendung von Produkten wie MuleSoft.* Du hast Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung; Kenntnisse der JAVA\-Programmiersprache und entsprechender Design\-Patterns.* Du kennst die gängigsten Schnittstellenprotokolle und \-paradigmen wie REST, SOAP, HTTP, JMS, MCP.* Du bist neugierig, basierend auf bestehenden Ökosystemen neue Digitalisierungsansätze/\-lösungen umzusetzen.* Du verfügst über Expertise in der Analyse von Prozess\- und Datenflüssen innerhalb und zwischen Unternehmen.* Du verstehst es, komplexe technische Sachverhalte gegenüber dem Business adressatengerecht und überzeugend zu vertreten.* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Abstraktionsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und Wissen zu teilen.* Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.* Du bringst die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Bern und bei unserem Kunden mit (100%\-Remote nicht möglich).**Was Du von uns erwarten darfst:*** Du findest bei uns eine herausfordernde und abwechslungsreiche Arbeit sowie spannende Projekte bei namhaften Playern in der Schweizer Unternehmenslandschaft.* Du bist Teil eines motivierten, erfahrenen Teams und findest bei uns Sparringpartner, die Dich unterstützen und weiterentwickeln.* Du profitierst von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen mit vielen Zusatzleistungen.* Dein Arbeitsort ist zentral in der Stadt Bern, bei unseren Kunden und im Home Office.![Valion AG]()* Valion AG  Monbijoustrasse 20  3011 Bern*jid6888da1jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Head of Engineering & Operations / CTO
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Engineering &amp; Operations / CTO--- Head of Engineering \& Operations / CTO=======================================**Über cyon**Seit 2003 helfen wir Menschen, ihre Ideen ins Internet zu bringen, heute für rund 50'000 Kundinnen und Kunden. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitenden und betreiben unsere Plattform in Basel mit 100 % erneuerbarer Energie.Wir stehen für persönlichen Support, einfache Produkte und digitale Selbstbestimmung. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sollen ihren digitalen Raum unabhängig von grossen Plattformen gestalten können. Ihre Daten bleiben in der Schweiz.Wir entwickeln cyon vom erfolgreichen Hosting\-Anbieter zu einer Plattform, auf der Menschen und KI\-Agenten digitale Projekte einfach, sicher und selbstbestimmt umsetzen können. Dafür suchen wir eine technische Führungspersönlichkeit, die unseren zuverlässigen Betrieb sichert und gleichzeitig die technologische Zukunft von cyon gestaltet.  **Deine Aufgaben*** **Führung** Du führst und entwickelst unsere Mitarbeitenden in Engineering \& Operations. Du stärkst Eigenverantwortung, entwickelst Führungspersönlichkeiten und schaffst Strukturen, in denen Teams wirksam zusammenarbeiten und gute Entscheidungen treffen können.* **Strategie und Prioritäten** Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung trägst du Verantwortung für cyon als Ganzes. Du verantwortest Budget, Personalplanung und Ressourcenallokation deines Bereichs und übersetzt Produktziele gemeinsam mit Business Development in eine verbindliche technische Roadmap.* **Architektur und Betrieb** Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Engineers entwickelst du die Zielarchitektur unserer Software und Infrastruktur weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheide getroffen und umgesetzt werden. Mit deinen Teams gewährleistest du einen sicheren Betrieb rund um die . Dazu gehören Monitoring, Pikett, Incident Management, Backup und Disaster Recovery. Gleichzeitig modernisierst du gezielt unsere bestehenden Systeme.* «**AI first, human accountable»** Du machst KI\-gestützte und agentische Arbeitsweisen zum selbstverständlichen Bestandteil unserer Engineering\-Organisation. Du erkennst, wo KI echten Mehrwert schafft, förderst den gezielten Einsatz und stellst Qualität, Sicherheit und menschliche Verantwortung sicher.* **Sicherheit und Datenschutz** Du verantwortest die technische Informationssicherheit, den Schutz unserer Infrastruktur und die Umsetzung technischer Datenschutzanforderungen. Du entwickelst Sicherheitsstandards und Risikomanagement gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung weiter.**Das bringst du mit*** **Führungserfahrung** Du hast technische Organisationen geleitet und Führungskräfte entwickelt. Maintenance (H/F)================================ **Missions :*** Réaliser les travaux de maintenance préventive, corrective et curative des machines conventionnelles, automatisées et à commande numérique pour les secteurs saphir et plasturgie ;  * Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la sécurité électrique des équipements de production ;  * Contribuer à l’amélioration des équipements afin de garantir la continuité de production et la qualité des produits, en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et de production.    **Responsabilités :*** Diagnostiquer les pannes électriques et les dysfonctionnements des systèmes de commande afin de rétablir la production ;  * Construction et/ou modification électriques des installations de production  * Appliquer les procédures de consignation et les règles de sécurité dans les limites de ses compétences et autorisations ;  * Contrôler le fonctionnement des équipements et des dispositifs de sécurité avant leur remise à disposition de la production ;  * Analyser les pannes récurrentes et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à fiabiliser les équipements ;  * Participer aux déménagements des machines et à l’installation, la mise en service et la modernisation des moyens de production ;  * Organiser ses interventions avec la production et les autres intervenants de maintenance selon les priorités définies ;  * Documenter les interventions et mettre à jour les schémas électriques et les dossiers techniques ;  * Identifier les besoins en pièces de rechange et contribuer à la disponibilité des composants critiques  * Accompagner les prestataires externes et transmettre aux équipes les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et de surveillance des équipements ;  * Veiller à la sécurité des personnes, au respect des consignes et au maintien en bon état des équipements.   **Profil :** * CFC d’automaticien, d’électricien ou formation équivalente, avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance de machines de production industrielle ;  * Maîtrise du diagnostic électrique, des appareils de mesure et de la lecture des schémas électriques ;  * Compétences en diagnostic sur automates et interfaces opérateur, avec des connaissances de base des commandes numériques et automates Fanuc, Siemens et Beckhoff ;  * Bonne compréhension des systèmes de chauffe et de régulation de température, ainsi que des interactions électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques ;  * Aisance avec les outils informatiques de maintenance et la documentation technique ; connaissances de base en anglais ;  * Des connaissances en robotique ( , Universal Robots) et en vision industrielle (Cognex) constituent des atouts ;  * Rigueur et sens des responsabilités en matière de sécurité ;  * Esprit d’analyse et approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes ;  * Autonomie et fiabilité dans l’exécution des interventions ;  * Capacité à collaborer avec les équipes de production et de maintenance ;  * Sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les priorités ;  * Réactivité et maîtrise de soi face aux arrêts de production ;  * Esprit d’initiative, bonne communication et orientation vers des solutions durables.   **Horaires de travail :** Service de piquet et 2x8 possible **Nous offrons :*** Vacances : 5 semaines par année \+ 1 semaine sur rattrapage ;  * Pause de 15min offerte ;  * Salaire versé flotte, ventes privées chez des marques prestigieuses, etc.) ;  * Environnement de travail sain, valorisant, dynamique et en constante évolution.   ![R. We offer an innovative, collaborative and thriving environment.**Mission**  The Chef de Partie is responsible for the preparation, production, and presentation of food within an assigned kitchen section. Working under the supervision of the Executive Sous\-Chef and Kitchen Sous\-Chef, the role ensures the consistent application of culinary standards, food safety requirements, and operational procedures.  As part of Les Roches' experiential learning environment, the Chef de Partie supports students during practical sessions by demonstrating professional culinary techniques and fostering a culture of excellence, professionalism, and hospitality.**Main Responsibilities  1\. Execute Food Production Activities**  \- Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes, production plans, and quality standards.  \- Ensure consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control.  \- Contribute to the smooth operation of daily kitchen activities within the assigned section.  **2\. Support Student Practical Training**  \- Assist students during practical kitchen sessions and operational service periods.  \- Demonstrate culinary techniques, kitchen organization, and professional work methods.  \- Promote discipline, teamwork, and compliance with operational standards.  **3\. Ensure Hygiene and Food Safety Compliance**  \- Maintain full compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and internal procedures.  \- Ensure cleanliness and organization of workstations, equipment, and storage areas.  \- Report any food safety or operational concerns to supervisors.  **4\. Maintain Kitchen Organization and Resources**  \- Assist with the proper storage, rotation, and handling of food products.  \- Support inventory counts and the monitoring of stock levels.  \- Contribute to reducing food waste and ensuring responsible use of resources.  **5\. Contribute to Operational Excellence**  \- Collaborate effectively with kitchen colleagues, instructors, and service teams.  \- Support special events, functions, and academic activities as required.  \- Actively contribute to maintaining a professional, positive, and guest\-focused kitchen environment.**Key Competencies**  Strong culinary fundamentals and technical cooking skills.  Good understanding of food safety and HACCP requirements.  Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.  Strong attention to detail and quality standards.  Team\-oriented mindset and collaborative approach.  Ability to support and guide students through example.  Flexibility and adaptability in a multicultural environment.**Key Indicators**  Compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.  Quality and consistency of food production.  Preparedness and organization of assigned kitchen section.  Student and instructor satisfaction during practical activities.  Contribution to waste reduction and proper stock management.  Reliability and teamwork within kitchen operations.![]( )jpid629dc80jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Curator
description: About HELVETIKA 1575HELVETIKA 1575 AG is a contemporary art gallery based in Zug, with a new gallery space opening on Rennweg in Zurich. We represent a deliberately small and selective group of international artists – from established names to mid\-career and emerging positions – and work closely with collectors, foundations and museums.We are looking for a Curator who will shape our exhibition programme and strengthen the gallery's institutional profile.The role**Position:** Curator  **Location:** Zurich, Switzerland  **Workload:** 100%  **Start date:** by arrangement  **Reports to:** Management (Stephan Jöbstl, Katerina Maliakina)You are responsible for the artistic programme of the gallery: exhibitions, artist development and institutional relationships. You work hands\-on in a small team and turn ideas into finished exhibitions, publications and placements.Key responsibilities* Develop and realise the annual exhibition programme in Zurich, including solo shows, group exhibitions and art fair presentations* Build and maintain close working relationships with our artists, including studio visits, production of new works and exhibition planning* Scout new artists and prepare well\-founded proposals for onboarding (established, mid\-career and emerging)* Develop institutional placements and partnerships with museums, foundations, biennials and curators* Write and edit exhibition texts, artist biographies, CVs, press releases and catalogue content* Coordinate exhibition logistics: loans, transport, insurance, installation and condition reports, together with the team* Represent the gallery at openings, art fairs and professional events, and contribute to collector and press relations* Plan your work in clear blocks with measurable goals and report progress in the weekly team meetingQualifications* A completed university degree in Art History, Curatorial Studies, Fine Arts, Cultural Management or a related field – or equivalent professional experience* At least 3 years of curatorial experience in a gallery, museum, foundation or art institution* A track record of exhibitions you have curated or co\-curated* A solid network among artists, curators and institutions, ideally in Switzerland and the DACH region* Excellent writing skills in English; German is a strong advantage, French a plus* Strong organisational skills, reliability and the ability to work independently and proactively in a small team* Confident, professional presence with artists, collectors and institutional partners* Willingness to travel (art fairs, studio visits, international exhibitions)What we offer* Real creative responsibility for the programme of a growing gallery with a new space in Zurich* Direct collaboration with the founders and short decision paths* Work with internationally recognised artists and institutional partners* A competitive salary based on experienceHow to applyPlease apply online with your CV, a short cover letter and a selection of exhibitions or projects you have curated. We look forward to hearing from you.j4id10475537jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm
