Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab Dezember 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n    * Durchführung von Massagen (Entspannungsmassagen, Tiefengewebsmassagen, Hot\-Stone\-Massagen, Schwangerschaftsmassagen) und Körperbehandlungen: Peelings, Wraps, Vichy\-Duschbehandlungen und Rituale gemäß den Protokollen* Durchführung von Behandlungen entsprechend den Vorlieben und dem Befinden der Gäste* Wahrung der Privatsphäre der Gäste und Einhaltung professioneller Grenzen* Durchführung von Beratungsgesprächen vor den Behandlungen und Nachsorgeberatungen für die Gäste nach den Behandlungen* Empfehlung geeigneter Spa\-Dienstleistungen und Verkaufsprodukte* Sicherstellung der Hygienevorschriften sowie Gesundheits\- und Sicherheitsbestimmungen* Vorbereitung und Reinigung der Behandlungsräume vor und nach jedem (saubere Wäsche, desinfizierte Utensilien, angenehme Atmosphäre)* Kontrolle des Produktverbrauchs und sichere Anwendung von Ölen, Lotionen und Utensilien  Sie bringen bereits Erfahrung aus der Hotellerie oder dem Spa\-Bereich mit und haben in der Massage und Kosmetik gearbeitet. Sie verfügen über einen Ausbildung an einer Massageschule oder vergleichbare Zertifikate. Um unsere anspruchsvolle Kundschaft verwöhnen zu können, sollten Sie geübt sein mehrere Wellness\-Massagen am Tag durchzuführen. Mit ihrer herzlichen und aufgestellten , fällt es Ihnen leicht, sich auf Deutsch und Englisch zu unterhalten.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     *Auszeichnungen:*   *Swiss Location Awards **«Switzerland's best meeting Location»***   *World Spa Awards **«Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»***   *LHW Membership Awards **«Sustainability Leader»***   *Great Place To Work 2025*   *The New York Times' **«52 Places to Go in 2018»***   *Travel \+ Leisure **«500 List 2021»***   *Handelszeitung **«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»** Connoisseur Circle **«Best Gourmet Hotel»**  MICHELIN Wellness Award **«Best Wellness Hotel»**  GALA Spa Awards **«Best Spa Concept»**  MICHELIN Keys **«3/3 Keys»***    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Koch  HR Assistant  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon      ******jidd636bd5jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Field Application Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to getting to know you!  Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams. Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.   Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.   *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment* .  *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Manufacturing Divisions and Company Entities. title: Responsable des relevés et décomptes
description: Responsable des relevés et décomptes  Introduction  Nous donnons un avenir aux maisons. Nous le faisons avec des produits et services qui aident à réduire les émissions de CO2 des bâtiments. Pour ce faire, nous gérons des données et des processus permettant de rendre les propriétés plus écologiques, sûres et confortables. La base de nos produits et services est numérique. Nous veillons à faciliter la transition vers nos technologies durables pour tous. Ainsi, nous permettons à chaque personne de contribuer à la protection du climat.  Nous avons déjà déployé plus de 48 millions d'appareils connectés dans le monde et développons des solutions pour des bâtiments écoénergétiques et résilients. Nous employons plus de 6 600 personnes dans 21 pays et nos produits et services sont utilisés dans plus de 14 millions de logements et bâtiments commerciaux dans le monde, chez plus de 460 000 clients. En 2025, le groupe ista élargi a généré un chiffre d'affaires de 1'287 millions d'euros.  Pour renforcer notre équipe en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e Responsable des relevés et décomptes motivé·e et engagé·e.  Ce qui t'attend chez nous  En tant que Responsable du suivi administratif et de la gestion des consommations, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans notre structure. Tes missions principales:  Calcul des consommations: Tu analyses les relevés de consommation et établis les décomptes individuels de chauffage et d’eau chaude destinés aux propriétaires, gérances et locataires.  Relation client: Tu es en contact direct avec nos clients et tu assures un accueil téléphonique de qualité.  Collaboration: Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en coordonnant avec les gérances et/ou les propriétaires.  Polyvalence: Tu prends part à d’autres tâches administratives selon les besoins.  Ce poste est fait pour toi si :  Tu es titulaire d’un CFC d’employé(e) de commerce.  Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en comptabilité immobilière, notamment réalisation de décomptes de frais de chauffages et frais accessoires.  Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome.  Tu aimes les chiffres et tu sais traiter les données avec précision.  Tu sais gérer une charge de travail importante sans compromettre la qualité.  Tu as le sens du service client.  Tu apprécies les contacts avec de nombreux interlocuteurs et gardes ton calme même lorsque les délais sont serrés.  Tu apprécies le travail en équipe.  Tu maîtrises les outils informatiques nécessaires dans un environnement numérique.  Tu parles aussi l’allemand au moins niveau B2 ? C’est un critère indispensable !  Tu parles aussi l’anglais ? C’est un atout !  Ce que nous t'offrons  De nombreuses opportunités et possibilités de faire bouger les choses activement et d'y contribuer.  Une activité variée, exigeante et autonome au sein d'une entreprise à envergure internationale.  Des conditions d'engagement attractives et des perspectives de développement à long terme.  De très bonnes offres pour ton perfectionnement personnel et professionnel.  Un environnement de travail performant et agréable au sein d'une équipe qui vise ensemble le succès.  Une organisation du travail flexible, adaptée à tes besoins.  Envie de nous rejoindre ?  Alors nous nous réjouissons de faire ta connaissance. Postule dès maintenant en ligne. jpid5eeeeb5jm jpit0937jm jpiy26jm

Our leaders are value\-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. They result from clear requirements, sound technical decisions, and effective collaboration throughout the entire product lifecycle. As a Product Engineer, you will help shape our Sensors \& Meters portfolio, from initial product concepts and feasibility studies through development and industrialization to continuous product improvement. You will take ownership of technically complex workstreams, coordinate cross\-functional contributors, and serve as a key technical contact for a defined part of our product portfolio.What You'll Do*      Develop and manage products throughout their entire lifecycle within the Sensors \& Meters portfolio, from initial concept through production and ongoing product improvement.*      Lead product\-related activities in development projects and act as a key interface between Product Owners, Product Management, R\&D Engineers, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and other engineering disciplines.*      Drive the successful realization of innovative product variants and feature enhancements by coordinating cross\-functional activities and ensuring the correct technical implementation.*      Coordinate cross\-functional product design activities, including FMEA, verification, validation, certification, and design transfer to production, while maintaining a holistic view across the product and its interfaces.*      Define, manage, and document product requirements and specifications, ensuring that technical requirements are clearly understood and correctly implemented.*      Drive product improvements, cost optimization, and complexity reduction as part of continuous portfolio development.*      Conduct feasibility studies, evaluate technical concepts, and support competitor assessments to shape and develop the product portfolio.*      Analyze product issues, determine root causes, implement corrective actions, and support quality cases, including design\-related quality topics.*      Ensure complete, accurate, and well\-maintained product documentation throughout the entire product lifecycle.*      Share knowledge, provide guidance to colleagues, and actively contribute to strengthening engineering capabilities within the team.Who you are* You hold a university degree in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a devices, or technically complex products.* You have a strong interdisciplinary understanding of systems and sound knowledge of requirements engineering.* You have a proven ability to lead complex structured, analytical, and solution\-oriented working style combined with a pragmatic approach to execution.* You are fluent in English; is an advantage. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995\.Compensation \& BenefitsAt Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Planificateur·trice -- Répartiteur·trice à 100% --- Planificateur·trice -- Répartiteur·trice à 100% ==================================================== \*\*Planificateur·trice -- répartiteur·trice à 100%\*\* \*\*Pourquoi nous rejoindre et nous faire confiance ?\*\* En intégrant notre équipe de planification, vous exercez une activité variée, en relation avec les équipes d'exploitation et au service de la mobilité régionale : • Contribuer concrètement à la continuité du service sur nos réseaux de transport. • Développer vos connaissances et vos compétences dans le domaine des transports publics. • Collaborer avec différents services et participer à l'amélioration des outils et des processus métier. • Bénéficier de formations sur les logiciels métier, la planification et la législation applicable. \*\*Vos missions :\*\* Rattaché·e à la personne responsable du service Développement de l'Offre et Planification, vous jouez un rôle central dans l'organisation des ressources et assurez la planification mensuelle ainsi que la répartition quotidienne du personnel, dans le respect du cadre légal et conventionnel. Vous élaborez les plannings en tenant compte des besoins d'exploitation, des compétences requises et, dans la mesure du possible, des souhaits des collaborateurs. Au quotidien, vous organisez les remplacements en cas d'absence et traitez les demandes de compensations, d'échanges et de congés. Vous coordonnez également les ressources nécessaires lors de travaux et d'événements, dans le respect du budget alloué, et assurez l'intégration des horaires correspondants dans les systèmes métier. Vous contribuez au suivi de l'activité en établissant les décomptes et statistiques mensuels relatifs aux heures de travail, aux kilomètres et aux ressources humaines, tout en veillant à la qualité des données et du reporting. Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, vous participez à la mise à jour des processus et de la documentation ainsi qu'au maintien et à l'évolution des outils métier, en collaboration avec les différents services de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre polyvalence, vous êtes également amené·e à assurer la suppléance du ou de la spécialiste planification de l'offre et des ressources pour la planification annuelle et les adaptations de l'offre en cours d'année. Vous apportez votre soutien à la préparation des ressources nécessaires aux travaux et événements et assurez la suppléance principale du coordinateur information voyageurs. \*\*Ce poste est fait pour vous si...\*\* • Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC d'agent·e de transports publics ou d'une formation équivalente. • Vous disposez d'une expérience en planification du personnel, en répartition et en gestion des absences dans les transports publics. • Vous maîtrisez la LDT et l'OLDT. • Vous utilisez avec aisance les outils usuels de planification et les logiciels bureautiques et êtes disposé·e à vous former aux applications spécifiques à notre activité. • Vous vous exprimez avec aisance en français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. • Vous avez le sens des priorités et gérez les imprévus avec calme et rigueur. • Vous alliez esprit d'équipe, écoute et diplomatie et traitez les demandes avec équité. • Vous êtes fiable et discret·ète et respectez la confidentialité des données, la sécurité et la sûreté. \*\*Type de contrat :\*\* CDI \*\*Entrée en fonction :\*\* dès que possible !\[Compagnie du chemin de fer Nyon-St-Cergue-Morez SA\]( ) \* Compagnie du chemin de fer Nyon\\-St\\-Cergue\\-Morez SA Rue de la Gare 45 1260 Nyon \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid22a71eejm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Comptable immobilier confirmé-e --- Comptable immobilier confirmé\\-e ================================= ### Introduction Gérances de Luze est une gérance immobilière familiale fondée en 1973 et implantée à Morges. Nous accompagnons les propriétaires et les locataires dans la gestion administrative et technique de portefeuilles résidentiels et commerciaux, ainsi que dans la location, la vente et l'expertise immobilière. Notre équipe d'une dizaine de collaborateurs intervient dans la région morgienne et sur l'arc lémanique avec proximité, discrétion et rigueur. ### Responsabilités En tant que Comptable immobilier confirmé\\-e, vous prenez en charge la comptabilité d'un portefeuille immobilier et contribuez à la fiabilité du suivi financier des immeubles, en collaboration avec les équipes de gérance. \* Tenir la comptabilité des immeubles et des copropriétés afin de garantir des comptes exacts et à jour. \* Enregistrer et contrôler les factures, encaissements, paiements et écritures comptables afin d'assurer un suivi financier fiable des propriétaires, locataires et fournisseurs. \* Effectuer les rapprochements bancaires et analyser les mouvements comptables afin d'identifier et de corriger rapidement les écarts. \* Préparer les décomptes de charges, les comptes de gestion et les bouclements afin de fournir une information financière claire aux propriétaires. \* Suivre les débiteurs et les créanciers afin de soutenir une gestion saine des liquidités et des obligations financières. \* Participer à la préparation des budgets, au contrôle des charges et au suivi de la rentabilité des title: Chef de Partie (m/w/d)
description: ## Kurz & knappArbeiten Sie gerne dort, wo Qualität mit Ruhe, Präzision und handwerklichem Können entsteht? In unserer Bankett- und Produktionsküche stehen strukturierte Abläufe, ein hoher Anspruch an Sorgfalt und die Liebe zum Detail im Mittelpunkt. Hinter den Kulissen entsteht hier die Grundlage für Genuss auf konstant hohem Niveau.**Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach einem Chef de Partie (m/w/d)****In der vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion als Chef de Partie (m/w/d) gehören folgende Tätigkeiten zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich:**- Vorbereitung und Produktion von Speisen für Bankette, Events, Buffets und Veranstaltungen unterschiedlicher Grössenordnungen- Fachgerechte Umsetzung der Rezepturen, Portionierungen und Vorgaben zum Anrichten der Speisen für die Les Trois Rois Bar- Gewährleistung einer einwandfreien Küchenabläufe sowie einer reibungslosen Vorbereitung und Service-Nachbereitung- Kontrolle der angerichteten Speisen am Posten hinsichtlich Geschmack, Qualität und Optik- Ermittlung des Lebensmittelbedarfs sowie Aufnahme und Weiterleitung der Warenbestellungen- Entgegennahme, Kontrolle und fachgerechte Verräumung der Lebensmittel- Erstellung von Menüvorschlägen und Tagesmenüs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vorgesetzten- Sicherstellung einer konstant hohen Qualität und optimalen Zubereitung der Speisen- Umsetzung und Kontrolle der hotelspezifischen Standards sowie der Vorgaben des Qualitätsmanagements- Einhaltung der geltenden Hygienevorschriften und Lebensmittelgesetze**Mit folgenden Eigenschaften überzeugen Sie uns:**- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie als Koch/Köchin mit anschliessender einschlägiger Berufserfahrung- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hygiene, HACCP sowie Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards; entsprechende Hygieneschulungen von Vorteil- Interesse an der Einarbeitung von Mitarbeitenden, Lernenden und Trainees, sowie erste Führungserfahrung- Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität- Teamorientierte, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit sicherem und professionellem Auftreten sowie guten Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten- Gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch und Französisch sind von Vorteil**Wir bieten:**- Ein dynamisches und motiviertes Team, das viel Freude an den Aufgaben hat- Ein lebendiges Umfeld in einem der führenden Häuser der Schweizer Luxushotellerie- Spezialpreise für Übernachtungen in den Häusern der Swiss Deluxe Hotels- Mitarbeiter- sowie Family & Friends-Vorteile im Les Trois Rois- Tolle Vergünstigungen z.B. 30% in der hoteleigenen Blumenboutique Fleurs des Rois- Europa Park-Vergünstigungen- Zentraler Arbeitsort direkt in der Basler Altstadt- Neu eröffnetes Mitarbeiterrestaurant mit Blick auf den RheinMöchten Sie Teil dieses motivierten Teams werden? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch heute. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!**Willkommen im Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois!**Das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois in Basel zählt mit seiner fast 350-jährigen Geschichte zu den traditionsreichsten Hotels Europas. Direkt am Rhein und im Herzen der Basler Altstadt gelegen, vereint es historischen Charme mit zeitloser Eleganz. Unter dem Motto «Rich in History, Young at Heart» verfolgt das Haus das Ziel, höchste Ansprüche zu erfüllen und seinen Gästen unvergessliche Erlebnisse zu bereiten. In 82 stilvoll ausgestatteten Zimmern und Suiten geniessen die Gäste exklusiven Komfort und gelebte Gastfreundschaft.Kulinarisch überzeugt das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois mit einem vielseitigen Angebot: dem Gourmet-Restaurant Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl, ausgezeichnet mit drei Michelin-Sternen, 19 GaultMillau-Punkten und 2025 von La Liste auf Platz 1 der weltbesten Restaurants geführt, der Brasserie Les Trois Rois mit 15 GaultMillau-Punkten sowie einer eleganten Bar mit preisgekrönten Cocktails.Ein neues Kapitel der Hotelgeschichte wurde mit dem von Herzog & de Meuron umgebauten Kopfgebäude aufgeschlagen. Entstanden sind neue Zimmer und Suiten, wandelbare Eventräume, das Restaurant Banks – Basels neuer Treffpunkt mit europäisch-asiatischer Küche und Sharing-Konzept – sowie der japanisch inspirierte Wellbeing-Bereich Seijaku, eine Oase der Ruhe inmitten der Stadt.

description: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)Pfäffikon SZ, SwitzerlandAbout the Company:We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.Your Role:As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.How You Will Contribute to Our Success:•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives.•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M&A, private equity and fundraising.•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.Requirements:•    A university degree (Master) with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship.•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analysis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence).•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leadership experience in Asia and the United Kingdom.•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.•    Languages: English and Russian.•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role.What We Offer:•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company.•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.•    A professional, ethical and performanceoriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development.Interested?If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future of an entrepreneurial asset management company, we look forward to hearing from you.We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and relevant supporting documents, by email to:Markus Marthalercontact@golden-hawk-invest.com

Für dessen Weiterentwicklung suchen wir eine Person, welche diesen Wandel aktiv mitgestaltet, Anforderungen strukturiert aufnimmt und fachliche Konzepte in umsetzbare Spezifikationen übersetzt. description: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)Pfäffikon SZ, SwitzerlandAbout the Company:We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.Your Role:As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.How You Will Contribute to Our Success:•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives.•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M&A, private equity and fundraising.•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.Requirements:•    A university degree (Master) with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship.•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analysis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence).•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leadership experience in Asia and the United Kingdom.•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.•    Languages: English and Russian.•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role.What We Offer:•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company.•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.•    A professional, ethical and performanceoriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development.Interested?If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to getting to know you!  Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams. Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.   Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.   *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment* .  *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. title: Business Development Director
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Development Director--- Business Development Director=============================**Entdecke deine nächste Karrierechance bei einem der größten Logistikdienstleister der Welt. Stelle dir die Vielzahl an Möglichkeiten vor, etwas zu bewegen und werde Teil eines großartigen Teams aus ganz unterschiedlichen Kulturen. Bei uns arbeitest du mit talentierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die dir dabei helfen, jeden Tag über dich hinauszuwachsen. Wir wissen, was nötig ist, um UPS in die Zukunft zu führen: Menschen mit einer einzigartigen Kombination aus Können und Leidenschaft. Wenn du die Eigenschaften und die Motivation besitzt, dich selbst oder dein Team zu führen, findest du bei uns den , der zu dir passt. Bei UPS erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen und deine Karriere auf ein neues Level zu bringen.** **Tätigkeitsbeschreibung:** Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics (formerly Marken, MNX \& Polar Speed), the clinical and advanced therapy subsidiary of UPS Healthcare, unites expertise across healthcare and complex secure logistics to drive the success of our clients through innovation.  **Purpose:**A Business Development Director works to improve an organization’s market position and achieve financial growth. This person defines long\-term organizational strategic goals, builds key customer relationships, identifies business opportunities, negotiates and closes business deals and maintains extensive knowledge of current market conditions. Business Development Directors work in a senior sales position within the company. It is their job to work with their internal team, marketing staff, and other Directors and Managers to increase sales opportunities and thereby maximize revenue for Marken. To achieve this, they need to find potential new customers, present to them, ultimately convert them into clients, and continue to grow business in the future. The Business Development Director will also help manage existing clients and ensure they stay satisfied and positive. They call on clients, often being required to make presentations on solutions and services that meet or predict their clients’ future needs. **Main Duties and Responsibilities:**The primary role of the Business Development Director is to prospect for new clients by networking, cold calling, advertising or other means of generating interest from potential clients. They must then plan persuasive approaches and pitches that will convince potential clients to do business with the company. They must develop a rapport with new clients, and set targets for sales and provide support that will continually improve the relationship. They are also required to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new solutions and services to clients. Business Development Directors work with mid and senior level management, marketing, and technical staff. He/she may manage the activities of others responsible for developing business for the company. Strategic planning is a key part of this job description, since it is the business manager’s responsibility to develop the pipeline of new business coming in to the company. This requires a thorough knowledge of the market, the solutions/services the company can provide, and of the company’s competitors. While the exact responsibilities will vary the main duties of the Business Development Director can be summarized as follows: **New Business Development*** Prospect for potential new clients and turn this into increased business.* Cold call as appropriate within your market or geographic area to ensure a robust pipeline of opportunities.* Meet potential clients by growing, maintaining, and leveraging your network.* Identify potential clients, and the decision makers within the client organization.* Research and build relationships with new clients.* Set up meetings between client decision makers and company’s practice leaders/Principals.* Plan approaches and pitches.* Work with team to develop proposals that speaks to the client’s needs, concerns, and objectives.* Participate in pricing the solution/service.* Handle objections by clarifying, emphasizing agreements and working through differences to a positive conclusion.* Use a variety of styles to persuade or negotiate appropriately.* Present an image that mirrors that of the client **Client Retention*** Present new products and services and enhance existing relationships.* Work with technical staff and other internal colleagues to meet customer needs. Arrange and participate in internal and external client debriefs. **Business Development Planning*** Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.* Present to and consult with mid and senior level management on business trends with a view to developing new services, products, and distribution channels.* Identify opportunities for campaigns, services, and distribution channels that will lead to an increase in sales.* Using knowledge of the market and competitors, identify and develop the company’s unique selling propositions and differentiators. **Management and Research*** Ensure that data is accurately entered and managed within SalesForce.* Track and record activity on accounts and help to close deals to meet these targets.* Research and develop a thorough understanding of the company’s people and capabilities.* Understand the company’s goal and purpose so that will continual to enhance the company’s performance. **Requirements: Education*** Bachelor’s degree* Minimum 5\-7 years of sales or marketing experience.  **der Anstellung:** Unbefristet UPS hat sich verpflichtet, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, der frei von Diskriminierung, Belästigung und Vergeltungsmaßnahmen ist.![UPS United Parcel Service (Schweiz) AG]()* UPS United Parcel Service (Schweiz) AG  Binningerstrasse 2, Spenglerpark  4142 Münchenstein*jid09b6c45jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Content & Product Specialist
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Content &amp; Product Specialist---Content \& Product Specialist=============================  ***Dear applicants, you have an assignment to complete at the bottom of this job add.***  ***Applications will not be considered if not complete.*** Definition of function and missionClinique La Prairie is a science\-based longevity company. Its value comes from turning medical innovation into programmes that people can understand, trust and book. As Product Content \& Education Specialist, you will know that science and that offer better than anyone outside the medical team. You will turn them into the content every team uses to explain the offer, sell it and prove it.This is a hands\-on expert role, built on writing and product knowledge. You write most of what you deliver yourself: brochures, web and sales copy, scripts, training content and briefs. Your value comes from how deeply you know the product and how well you write.The role sits in Strategic \& Product Marketing and reports to the Head of Strategic \& Product Marketing. On one side are Innovation and Medical; on the other are , Digital, PR, APAC and the properties. Product creates the content and those teams use it. Your work covers the whole guest journey, from the first video a prospect sees to the brochure a sales advisor sends and the e\-learning module a new team member completes.In 2027, CLP's priority is to own scientific and medical excellence in longevity. No competitor holds this ground yet, and CLP's programmes and doctors already earn it. Most of the evidence exists inside the company but has not yet been made public. Your mission is to publish it accurately, in the brand's voice, across every destination.The role succeeds when:* Every destination presents the offer the same way, using the latest version.  * Each programme or offer update reaches every material quickly and without errors.  * Public content relies more on science, in line with the 2027 mix for Longevity Talks: 40% science, 30% performance, 30% personalities.  * The content supports the 2027 KPIs: programmes sold and average price in Montreux, content performance, and CLP's share of AI answers on scientific and medical excellence.   ResponsibilitiesA. Product Expertise \& Innovation\-to\-Market *Purpose: be the marketing team's reference on what CLP offers and why it works, and make sure every innovation reaches the market accurately.** Master the full portfolio, by destination (Montreux, Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs): every programme, protocol, pillar, diagnostic and treatment, plus the CLP Method and the science behind it.  * Build and maintain the Product Knowledge Base, with one source of truth per programme: content, duration, price structure, inclusions, approved claims, medical references and differences by destination.  * Build and maintain, with Medical, a library of evidence that can be made public: studies, the scientific committee, doctor profiles, results and data.  * Be marketing's day\-to\-day contact for Innovation and Medical on product content. Follow the innovation pipeline, attend product reviews and learn about changes before they launch.  * Check scientific accuracy and claims with Medical, and with Legal where needed, before any content is published.  * For each programme or offer change, list every affected asset (brochures, toolkit, e\-learning, website, guest communications) and track it until all are updated.  * Write the launch package for each new programme or update: key messages, sales narrative, FAQs and internal briefing.  * Answer product questions from , Digital, PR, Regional teams and the properties.  * Provide verified product and scientific content for the website and its knowledge base.   B. Offer \& Content ( \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit) *Purpose: give and every property the tools to present one standard offer and to hold a consultative, client\-led conversation.** Write and maintain the content of the \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit, covering Global , Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs and internal enablement. Keep its SharePoint structure and version control up to date.  * Write and update brochures, one\-pagers, commercial fact sheets and programme summaries, all built on one standard offer across Resorts and Hubs.  * Write pre\-booking templates, welcome communications and guest preparation materials.  * Prepare the content package for new openings, such as the upcoming Longevity Hub in New York  * Send each update to the markets with a short note on what changed, and withdraw outdated versions.   C. Scientific \& Content for the Funnel *Purpose: turn CLP's science, doctors and guest stories into content that Digital, PR, and regional teams can use at each stage of the funnel.** Write storylines, scripts and briefs for video shoots with doctors and experts, so that medical expertise becomes clear and engaging content.  * Develop topics, storylines and briefs for Longevity Talks and Guest Testimonials, with science at the centre of the mix.  * Create content for each stage of the funnel, from awareness to consideration and conversion, and adapt it to CLP's customer personas (Achiever, Optimiser, Purist), including their motivations, expectations and preferred formats.  * Write the content for educational formats aimed at prospects, such as webinars, and prepare the experts who present them.  * Provide scientific and product content for digital channels such as the website, newsletter and social media, which the Digital team then publishes. The scope may later extend to newsletter strategy.  * Write background content on programmes, experts and CLP's scientific credentials to support PR.  * Brief regional adaptations so that each market has relevant proof, voices and language versions.  * Give product and scientific input to brand campaigns and video productions.   D. Internal Education \& Enablement *Purpose: make sure everyone who speaks for CLP understands the offer, the science and the brand, and can explain them with confidence.** Write the annual brand and product education agenda.  * Lead the e\-learning project end to end: write the scripts for the quarterly modules, organise and brief the video shoots, and coordinate the launch with HR, building on the three chapters already delivered.  * Write and present product training for and property teams at each launch and opening.  * Write onboarding materials and internal fact sheets for new and existing teams.  * Propose a simple way to check product knowledge after each module, such as a short quiz or certification.   Profile requirementsEducation \& experience* A degree in communication, journalism, literature or marketing. A background in life sciences, health or nutrition is a strong plus. A science degree combined with a proven copywriting record will also be considered.  * 3 to 5 years as a copywriter, content writer, editor or journalist, ideally for scientific, medical, health, beauty or luxury brands (for example pharma, medtech, dermo\-cosmetics, medical wellness or luxury hospitality).  * A writing portfolio is required. It should show premium brand copy and complex science explained for non\-specialists. Shortlisted candidates complete a writing test.  * Fluent English (written to publication standard) and French. , Italian, Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.   Skills \& competenciesCopywriting and editorial (the core of the role)* An outstanding copywriter in English, writing to publication standard: headlines, brochure and web copy, sales copy, video and webinar scripts, social captions and newsletter content.  * Writes long\-form content (brochures, dossiers, e\-learning) and short\-form content (one\-pagers, captions, hooks) with the same precision.  * Turns complex medical and scientific information into clear, accurate and compelling copy, without overclaiming.  * Adapts tone for guests, sales advisors, partners, press and internal teams, and keeps the CLP brand voice consistent across every destination.  * Edits and proofreads rigorously, both their own copy and other people's.  * Has a strong visual eye for photography, video and layout, in line with CLP's luxury and scientific identity.   Product and scientific mastery* Able to read a clinical study or scientific paper and explain it accurately in plain language.  * Understands longevity, diagnostics, biomarkers and cellular health, and knows the difference between evidence, claims and marketing language.  * Learns a complex portfolio quickly and keeps the details precise.  * Asks the questions that doctors and Innovation need to answer before content is published.   Organisation and ownership* Owns recurring content cycles and completes updates without senior follow\-up.  * Keeps many documents, versions and deadlines moving at the same time, with strict version control.   Collaboration* Works easily with doctors, scientists, Innovation, Operations, , PR, Creative, Digital and local teams, across cultures.  * Proactive, autonomous and solution\-oriented.   Tools* Strong PowerPoint ,Word, and Excel skills; Indesign and other graphic tools are a plus.  * Comfortable with SharePoint libraries and structured content systems.   APPLICATION ASSIGNEMENT TO BE ADDED WITH YOUR CV: * Time: around 3 hours.  * Language: English.  * Format: one Word or PDF document, with each piece clearly titled.  * Sources: use credible public sources, such as scientific studies, medical societies and recognised market research. Name the source of every figure or study you use.  * Judgement: you may define what the programme includes, based on what you know of CLP's approach: a medical assessment and our four pill
